questions.q:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions that follow:

The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) represents a paradigm shift in the architecture of modern banking. Central banks across emerging and developed economies are exploring CBDCs not merely as a digital surrogate for physical banknotes, but as a programmable settlement infrastructure capable of reducing clearing friction and democratizing financial access. Proponents argue that the distributed ledger underpinnings of retail CBDCs can foster financial inclusion by granting unbanked populations direct access to sovereign digital fiat without the intermediation fees traditionally levied by commercial banks.

However, this technological leap is a double-edged sword. While retail CBDCs enhance transactional velocity, they also threaten the disintermediation of commercial banking deposits during periods of economic distress. If depositors can seamlessly transfer their savings from commercial bank deposits to risk-free central bank digital liabilities with a single tap on a smartphone, the speed of bank runs could accelerate to precipitous levels. Furthermore, the deployment of machine learning algorithms in autonomous credit underwriting and fraud detection, while exponentially faster than manual underwriting, introduces opaque algorithmic bias. When neural networks train on historical lending datasets, they inadvertently perpetuate systemic socio-economic disparities under the veneer of objective statistical computation.

To mitigate these vulnerabilities, regulatory frameworks must evolve beyond post-facto compliance. Financial watchdogs must mandate algorithmic explainability (XAI) and impose strict holding limits or tier-based remuneration on CBDC wallets to curb abrupt capital flight. Technological innovation must harmonize with prudential safeguards to preserve both systemic stability and equitable access.

Question 1: What is the primary purpose of the passage?
options: To analyze the transformative potential of CBDCs and AI in banking alongside their systemic and algorithmic risks
To advocate for the complete replacement of traditional commercial banking with digital currencies
To criticize central banks for prematurely deploying unverified distributed ledger technologies
To explain the mathematical algorithms governing neural networks in credit scoring

Eight IT professionals — P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, and W — reside in a four-storey building where floors are numbered 1 to 4 from bottom to top. Each floor has two flats: Flat A and Flat B. Flat A is to the west of Flat B. Flat A of floor 2 is immediately above Flat A of floor 1 and immediately below Flat A of floor 3, and so on. Each flat is occupied by exactly one professional.

5. T lives on an odd-numbered floor immediately below U, but in different flat types.
6. V does not live on floor 1, and V lives in Flat B.

Statement: In response to multiple ransomware incursions targeting regional rural banks, the banking ombudsman has mandated that all commercial and cooperative lenders migrate to air-gapped, immutable offline data backup repositories within sixty days.

Neither argument I nor II is strong
